reviews.title: Seriously need a Screen Time password to delete the app that I paid for myself?
reviews.text:
Of course there are different stages to having ADHD, and I got this app, thinking it would help me with focusing, but really instead it’s honestly just a timer that you have to wait for to then upgrade your room because after a while this sort of just became a ‘ push the button wait a couple of hours and then decorate the room’ as I went on to probably not do anything proactive. It’s a waiting game. I bought the yearly subscription because I wanted to have more time because the two hour limit was too short for me. But even after that, you can’t customize your own little character instead, you have to pay money to. I hope this app finds someone that is actually useful to them. But I honestly don’t see how this isn’t the same as me setting a timer on my phone… 

The concept is extremely cute, I just don’t think it was ready to be released and especially not after completing all of the rooms, which makes them the app feel useless since you’re earning socks or scarfs for nothing because it’s not like you’re going to change anything…

And before you download this app, do make sure you remember your own Screen Time password since that’s the only way to remove this app… sense of course I ran into that problem and have to go get my own iPad that I downloaded this app by myself toyed around to get this off my storage plan 

I hate leaving negative reviews because I didn’t have any negative reviews starting off when I got this app. And hopefully I didn’t ramble too much for developers
